address: Place de la Fontaine et des Platanes, Nonza, 20217, France
bio: A small, listed village on the Cap Corse road is home to this demure restaurant, hidden by a curtain of Virginia Creeper and tall plane trees. The chef unveils his know-how as he crafts painstakingly sourced, local and seasonal ingredients, illustrated by ultra-fresh croaker, pancetta and pork jus in a surf and turf recipe of wondrous harmony. Love at first bite....
